summary.text: Randy McNally is a Republican state senator from Oak Ridge representing Tennessee Senate District 5 (Anderson, Knox and Loudon Counties). His page lists him as Lieutenant Governor and Speaker of the Senate (110th General Assembly) and as a senator since the 95th.

paragraphs.text: McNally was born on January 30, 1944, graduated from Oak Ridge High School in 1962, and earned a B.S. from Memphis State University in 1967 and a degree from the University of Tennessee College of Pharmacy in 1969.
He is a retired pharmacist, married, with two children.
McNally served in the House for the 91st through 94th General Assemblies before moving to the Senate.
His page lists honors including the Distinguished Service Award of the University of Tennessee College of Pharmacy (1996) and recognition as Republican Legislator of the Year in 1990.
